description.narrative: The initiative aims to empower women in Lao Cai province to develop green livelihoods and adapt to climate change, through a circular economy model from the indigenous banana value chain (especially the Tien Vua Yen Hop indigenous banana variety). The initiative combines improving technical capacity, applying science and technology in farming, processing, and processing environmentally friendly by-products, in order to create sustainable jobs, reduce agricultural waste, and contribute to environmental protection. Activity: Surveying the current situation of planting, caring for and processing bananas in Xuan Ai, Lam Giang and Tan Hop communes. Developing and compiling technical documents on organic banana farming. Organized 03 technical training classes(theory + practice). Settingup 01 model of growing bananas in an organic direction for practice. Organized 02 training courses on banana processing techniques (drying, vinegar, wine...). Organizing trial processing practices in households or groups. Support packaging and label design, associated with OCOP criteria. Establishment and support of activities for 01 group/group of women processing. Participate in 01 local product introduction event or fair. Organizing training on techniques for handling by-products and waste products from bananas. Building a circular economy model of bananas in households/production groups. Compilation of a technical manual for handling banana by-products/waste products on a household scale. Monitoring and evaluating the results of byproduct/waste treatment at the model Project areas: Xuan Ai Commune, Lam Giang Commune, Tan Hop Commune, Lao Cai Province Duration: 12 months Target groups/Beneficiaries: The main target is rural women

participating-org.narrative: Center of crop research for adaptat

Center of crop research for apdaptation to climate change is a public science and technology organization under the University of Agriculture and Forestry, Thai Nguyen University. The Center was established by the University Council and operates in accordance with the Law on Science and Technology dated June 18, 2013; Decree No. 08/2014/NĐ-CP dated January 27, 2014 of the Government detailingand guiding the implementation of a number of articles of the Law on Science and Technology; the regulations on the organization and operation of the University of Agriculture and Forestry; and other related legal documents. The Center is under the management of competent State authorities.
Objectives of the Center To provide training, conduct scientific research, and transfer technologies; to organize the production and business of agricultural and forestry products and services that are adaptive to climate change, meeting the needs of society.
Orientation for the Center’s activities By 2025, the Center aims to become a reputable institution for training, research, and technology transfer in the field of climate-resilient agriculture and forestry. By 2030, the Center strives tobecome a Research Institute with sufficient capacity to meet national and international requirements for training and research.
The Center provides training, conducts research, and transfers scientific and technological advances; organizes production, business activities, and quality testing of agricultural, forestry, food, livestock, veterinary, and environmental products and services to meet societal needs; and offers science and technology services, including quality testing of products and goods in the fields of agriculture, forestry, food, veterinary science, and the environment.
